keyEvents.text: Goal! Pamplona 0, Eibar 1. Javi Martón (Eibar) header from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Pejiño.
Eric Pérez (Eibar) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Pamplona 0, Eibar 2. Jon Magunazelaia (Eibar) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Pejiño.
Odei Pérez De Heredia González (CD Pamplona) Substitution at 50'
keyEvents.shortText: Odei Pérez De Heredia González S

keyEvents.text: Adrián Pardo Amat (CD Pamplona) Substitution at 51'
Goal! Pamplona 0, Eibar 3. Jon Magunazelaia (Eibar) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Lucas Núñez.
Fernando Francés Simón (CD Pamplona) Substitution at 60'
Javier Barber Sanz (CD Pamplona) Substitution at 61'
Adrián Pardo (Pamplona) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
